name: follower
effect: Followers take a turn immediately before or after you (your choice, unless they where created that turn) however they will only ever roll 3d6. All of your Followers use these same 3 dice regardless of type.

name: wet
effect: When applied to a target with Burn, remove Wet and all Burn. When a Wet creature gains Burn, they take damage equal to the Burn gained and lose Wet and all Burn.

name: focus
effect: Lasts until you roll a 1 on a Dodge roll, the duration ends, you have 0 health, gain stacks of Stun, cast another Focus Spell, or drop the spell.

name: hidden
effect: You cannot be seen or targeted directly and a creature must spend ## to do a Senses Contest against your FINESSE to know of your presence. You lose Hidden if you activate an Art, do an Attack, or you are detected through a Senses roll.

name: unconscious
effect: You can't take actions, lose all contests, and fail all Dodge rolls.

name: grappled
effect: You are Rooted and can't Attack anything other than the source of the grapple. You may spend ## to do a BODY Contest against the source of the grapple to remove this effect.

name: exhaustion
effect: Stacks. You have -X on all Checks and Contests, and have -3*X Max Strain. At 4 or more, you gain 1 Death's Door every hour. Lose 1d4 Exhaustion at the end of a Rest.

name: burn
effect: At the beginning of your turn take damage equal to the amount of Burn then half the number of Burn stacks (rounded up).

name: knockback
effect: Are pushed back X tiles. If a target is pushed into another target both targets take damage equal to however much they would have moved.

name: slow
effect: You have half your SPEED (rounded up). This is taken into effect before any other changes to SPEED.

name: rooted
effect: Your SPEED is 0 and it cannot be increased.

name: marked
effect: A creature may spend Marked when Attacked or on Contests, to gain +1 on the Attack Sum or roll (does not effect Bonus/Downside).

name: stun
effect: Stacks. You roll X less Combat Dice at the start of your turn, to a minimum of 2, or have -X on your next Check or Contest (whichever happens first). Then lose all Stun.

name: blind
effect: Cannot do ranged actions, have -1 to Senses rolls, and enemies have +1 Dodge from your attacks.

name: glowing
effect: You emit light covering up to 2 tiles away from you. You cannot become Hidden, Cloaked, or Invisible and lose these if you have them.

name: cloaked
effect: You may spend Cloaked to become Hidden or gain +1d6 damage on an Attack.

name: empowered
effect: You may spend Empowered to gain Advantage on a Check, gain an Attack's Bonus, or not have an Attack's Downside.

name: ward
effect: You may spend Warded to re-roll a Dodge or Contest roll, or to remove a Bane.

name: invisible
effect: You cannot be seen at all, have no shadow, and have Advantage on Hidden Contests.

name: obscured
effect: (Not realy a thing anymore, tell "bertle." about this.) You cannot be targeted by non-area ranged actions, or seen from a distance.

name: rallied
effect: (Not realy a thing anymore, tell "bertle." about this.) Pick a Stat when you first gain Rallied. You get +1d4 on Checks and Contests on that stat.

name: reinforced
effect: (Not realy a thing anymore, tell "bertle." about this.) When you roll a Check, Contest, or Dodge roll you may not have less than +1 on the roll.
